mentions.name: LÖVE2D game programming learning project
mentions.description: A game programming project built with Lua and LÖVE2D, used to get back into game development with a focus on learning the LÖVE framework and keeping the code well organized.
mentions.source_excerpt: Finally started getting back into game programming and have been working with Lua and Love2D - been trying my best not to get bogged down in the weeds (eg how do I animate a 3d cube on a 2d plane?) and I’m focusing on learning how to actually work with the Love system and organize my code. I’m getting a crash course in jj as an added bonus!
